Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Meio Wyror: 35-year-old man, 182 cm (tall), exceptional bodybuilder construction with enormous but coherent human muscle mass, skin value band-1-lightest. Face: long narrow face; large hooded eyes and a broken brow line; long straight nose, narrow upper lip; one cheek mole. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: black, bun-topknot-wrapped, deliberate accent: wrapped contrasting band. Wardrobe: quilted-outerwear, specifically lightly quilted cloth outerwear over a simple fitted layer and tapered trousers; a divided hem and broad folded collar; bounded palette rust-charcoal. Visible personal details: an extensive matte botanical tattoo language over one shoulder, torso edge, and forearm. Make body construction and habitual posture the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: visible mending treated as prideful craft. Color treatment: lets faded and repaired areas vary the palette. Pose cue: weight settles into one heel, shoulders square, hands relaxed and completely visible. Include a polished seed case only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow.
